entry.title: New: Resolution 691 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
URGES THE HAWAI‘I HOUSING FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION AND THE PLANNING DIRECTOR TO APPROVE THE KA LEI MOMI LANAKILA HOMES AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECT, LOCATED ON AN 8.65-ACRE PORTION OF THE PROPERTY IDENTIFIED BY TAX MAP KEY NO. 2-4-028:007 IN HILO, HAWAIʻI, SUBJECT TO THE NINTH PROCLAMATION RELATING TO AFFORDABLE HOUSING ISSUED BY GOVERNOR OF THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI

The Hawaiʻi Public Housing Authority propose to construct 22 two-story buildings to provide 257 affordable housing units to households earning 60 percent or less of the area median income.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 691-24 & GOEAC-168 - 11/20/2024
